items.title: Flatness and its relatives through the pushout equivalence of schemes over a fibre square
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: In the situation of the chapter's pushout equivalence lemma (a fibre square of schemes with closed immersion and the functors F and G between schemes over Y' and triples), the lemma asserts that for G(V, U', phi) the properties locally of finite type, flat, flat and locally of finite presentation, smooth and etale hold of V' -> Y' exactly when they hold of both V -> Y and U' -> X', and moreover that for W' flat over Y' the adjunction G(F(W')) -> W' is an isomorphism, so F and G restrict to mutually quasi-inverse equivalences on the flat loci. The retained proof reduces the whole bundle of assertions, by looking over affine pieces, to the corresponding algebra statement on properties of algebras over fibre products (More on Algebra), with affineness of the pushout square supplied by the setup lemma. Retained author proof at lines 4425-4430.
